vetSays.line: 🛡️ Liam, Ingrid, Gina, Gunther and Miguel met them at the door — 5 put down. Ingrid, Gina, Gunther, Miguel are hurt.
🛡️ Liam, Ingrid, Miguel, Sofia and Owen met them at the door — 5 put down. Liam, Ingrid, Miguel, Sofia, Owen are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader The Big Beast (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
🛡️ Gina, Gunther, Miguel, Catalina and Sofia met them at the door — 5 put down. Gina, Gunther, Miguel, Catalina, Sofia are hurt.
🛡️ Gunther, Nikos and Sofia met them at the door — 2 put down. Sofia didn't come back. Gunther, Nikos are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nikos just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Miguel, Nikos and Meera met them at the door — 2 put down. Meera didn't come back. Miguel is hurt.
Jovan keeps coming back to Nikos’s tale of Gavel — and now has a beast to hunt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nikos just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Miguel, Nikos and Aanya met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Miguel, Nikos, Aanya are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aisling just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
You STRIKE the Scarred Big Ugly for 195 (Hardlight knife).
The Scarred Big Ugly falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Big Ugly!

killerTaleLog: [day 14] Owen: The fire settles. Owen has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Mosquito — I put it down today." "Whining, closing. It circles — the sound gets closer." "The whine steadies — DIVE. Telegraphed." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ingrid says "So it bleeds." Miguel mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 14] Liam: The fire settles. Liam has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Heckler — I put it down today." "'You call that a swing?' The words CUT. Shame stacks." "'Oh, it's TRYING again!' Double shame — it smells blood." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Owen says "Say that again — slower." Ingrid says quietly "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 16] Gina: The fire settles. Gina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nostalgia — I put it down today." "The air fills with light — YOUR memories, projected huge. The beam follows your gaze. MOVE." "The reel stutters — outtakes. Embarrassing ones. Close up." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Sofia breathes "We've been walking past those." Liam mutters "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 19] Ingrid: The fire settles. Ingrid has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Paparazzo — I put it down today." "The flash charges — whine rising. When it fires, you freeze in place." "Every shot refines its model — hit or miss. At 4, the money shot is unavoidable." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Catalina says "Say that again — slower." Owen mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 21] Catalina: The fire settles. Catalina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Mountain Lord — I put it down today." "It crouches low, tail lashing once, twice. The stripes go still. Then it comes." "A paw rises, claws out — casual, almost lazy. It is not lazy." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikos says quietly "So it bleeds." Sofia breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 21] Gina: The fire settles. Gina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Tick — I put it down today." "It waits. The questing legs wave — the tell." "Adjacent = attached. No dodge. It's ON you." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Catalina says quietly "Say that again — slower." Sofia says "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 23] Nikos: The fire settles. Nikos has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Static Kite — I put it down today." "The 3x3 scan-mark burns into the ground. The mark is the mercy — MOVE." "It descends to transmit — melee-vulnerable, +50% damage. The only window." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ingrid asks "And you're still standing." Sofia says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 23] Ingrid: The fire settles. Ingrid has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sunbasker — I put it down today." "Its scales go from dull brown to molten gold. Heat shimmers off its back. It's ready." "It goes still in the sun. Gold spreads across its back — the charge is building." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Gina says "Tell me you didn't go alone." Rafael breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 23] Sofia: The fire settles. Sofia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Moderator — I put it down today." "It reviews you. 'Content noted.' A weak ranging chip while it decides." "'REMOVAL NOTICE.' Defiant or compliant — the hammer is coming down." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Gunther says quietly "So it bleeds." Catalina asks "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 24] Catalina: The fire settles. Catalina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Understudy — I put it down today." "It watches your weapon. It lifts its own — a perfect, insulting copy at half fidelity." "It starts performing — and your most-used move is suddenly anticipated, halved, ANSWERED." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ingrid mutters "So it bleeds." Gunther mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 31] Miguel: The fire settles. Miguel has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Landlord — I put it down today." "It plants a sign in the ground around you. NOTICE SERVED. The ground is claimed." "You ended your turn on claimed ground. The rent is due. It rises with every Addendum." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikos mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Gunther mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 34] Gunther: The fire settles. Gunther has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Cliffhanger — I put it down today." "It goes perfectly still. Only the eyes move. Then the water explodes — and the world starts spinning." "It has your leg. The roll starts. Do NOT let it reach the water." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Rafael says "Tell me you didn't go alone." Gina asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 34] Miguel: The fire settles. Miguel has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Inspiration — I put it down today." "It brightens. The light is too white, too certain. EUREKA — the biggest burst so far." "It flickers — a smaller, meaner idea. Less certain, faster." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Catalina breathes "Say that again — slower." Nikos mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 34] Catalina: The fire settles. Catalina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Extended Warranty — I put it down today." "RING. RING. The sound is inside your skull. 'We have been trying to REACH you about your—'" "It dials faster. More voices. All of them want to talk about your coverage." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Rafael says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Gina mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 36] Ingrid: The fire settles. Ingrid has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Union Rep — I put it down today." "'BROTHERS! SISTERS!' Allied monsters hit harder. The speech is the weapon." "'WHO'S WITH ME?' Help is coming." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Sofia asks "We've been walking past those." Miguel asks "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 39] Catalina: The fire settles. Catalina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Bulldozer — I put it down today." "Lowers its head, paws the earth. Dust rises. It is not going around the tree. It has never gone around anything." "It stops. Blood on its snout, sides heaving. It has decided you are not worth dying for — it backs away, quills flat." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Gina asks "Say that again — slower." Nikos asks "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 42] Gunther: The fire settles. Gunther has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Drum-Belly — I put it down today." "It rears up, belly swelling drum-taut, and beats it with both paws — BOOM. The air itself flinches." "It waddles left, then is suddenly right — a feint, testing whether your eyes or your ears are in charge." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Gina says quietly "So it bleeds." Nikos says quietly "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 49] Nikos: The fire settles. Nikos has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Gavel — I put it down today." "It raises the gavel-head high. The sound-block swings forward as a shield. It names your crime first — a full round before the verdict falls." "It names your crime out loud — a real thing you did. The courtroom goes quiet. The naming IS the wound." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Catalina says quietly "And you're still standing." Miguel mutters "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 50] Nikos: The fire settles. Nikos has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Murkcap — I put it down today." "The gills begin to breathe — a sweet, wrong smell rolls out from under the cap. The air shimmers." "The cap tilts. The stem creaks like a ship's mast. Get out from under it." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Gunther says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Rafael asks "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 61] Nikos: The fire settles. Nikos has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Ad Break — I put it down today." "A giant floating AD glyph with a PROGRESS BAR — the bar is the telegraph. During the pause it repositions and heals, and you watch. After the bar fills, a 'skip ad' beat appears: skip faster if the audience likes you. Or look away — the ad's power is that you WATCH." "A glowing can rotates beside it — ‘THIS REGENERATION BROUGHT TO YOU BY—’ It drinks. It heals." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Jovan mutters "And you're still standing." Aisling says quietly "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

regDeaths.name: a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong
a crow that watches too long and blinks too little
